qs.s: Elle a fait un ___ droit sur l'icône pour ouvrir le menu.

qs.en: A simple mouse click is enough to open the file.

qs.en: The ballpoint pen makes a characteristic click when you press it.

qs.en: A sharp click was heard when the door locked.

qs.en: I heard a distinct click coming from the mouse.

qs.en: After the click, the page loaded immediately.

qs.en: My father goes to the hairdresser every month to trim his beard and hair.

qs.en: The customer asked the hairstylist to curl her hair for the evening.

qs.en: This hairstylist is renowned for his modern cuts and trendy colors.

qs.s: ___ coiffeur de ce salon est très professionnel.
qs.en: The hairdresser of this salon is very professional.

qs.en: The bishop received his episcopal consecration during a solemn mass at Notre-Dame.

qs.en: This Nobel Prize is the crowning recognition of a lifetime devoted to research.

qs.en: His election to the Académie française was the crowning recognition of his career as a writer.

qs.en: The new cardinal's consecration will take place in St. Peter's Basilica.

qs.en: Winning this international award represents a rare crowning recognition for such a young artist.
